description: Election Commission - Declare that M. A. U. N. S. T. Fernando as a member of the Deraniyagala PS
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Deraniyagala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local authority, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by a political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
